notes: Export progress bar now shows real compression progress based on actual bytes written — no more stalling at 95% or 99%
Export save/share step has proper timeouts so exports never hang — the file lands in your cache even if the share sheet is slow
Import no longer rejects large files with a size limit — any ZIP size is accepted
Pinned artist photos use library cover art converted to data URLs — works offline, no more blank tiles
Albums and Playlists are fully independent — switching between them no longer shows the wrong songs or corrupts your playlist order
Kebab menu labels now show "Albums" when in Albums mode instead of a stale playlist name
